nodes.dialogue: The cart's practical details now press against a feeling neither wants to simplify.{pause}Mina folds the paper list along an old crease that has survived many indecisive Sundays.{pause}Their jokes grow gentler when nostalgia and a small budget pull in different directions.{pause}The honor move will decide whether today's find becomes a toy, an artifact, or a shared{pause}story.{pause}A quieter beat follows, where uncertainty can stay present without forcing a quick answer.

nodes.name: Warm End: Next Rain - Quiet Beat
nodes.speaker: Mina
nodes.dialogue: Sunday rain combs the window in silver lines while the warm counter light stays stubbornly{pause}gold.{pause}Neither needs the other to want the same cart; the shared skill is listening without selling.{pause}A worn label asks for care; a clean save asks for play; a bent manual asks to be remembered.{pause}Only then do they move, carrying the consequence forward instead of resetting at the next{pause}screen.{pause}Mina leaves the shelf slot empty; a paper tag promises NEXT RAIN, NO RUSH.

nodes.name: Awning Breath
nodes.speaker: Niko
nodes.dialogue: I step under the awning before buying anything.{pause}Loose carts settle with soft clicks, quieter than coins and somehow more persuasive.{pause}A quiet thank-you passes between them when one notices what the other was too excited to see.{pause}The rain will stop eventually, so the meaning of the purchase must survive beyond its perfect{pause}mood.{pause}They start with the visible detail, letting the cart be ordinary before it becomes{pause}important.

nodes.name: Awning Breath - Detail
nodes.speaker: Niko
nodes.dialogue: Wanting slowly feels strange, but good.{pause}The shop tune circles four playful notes, leaving enough space for the kettle behind it.{pause}Niko hears Mina's rule as permission to pause, not another test a new collector can fail.{pause}Every callback narrows the choice until Niko can explain the reason without borrowing Mina's words.{pause}The next observation complicates the wish and calls an earlier collector rule back into focus.

nodes.name: Awning Breath - Turn
nodes.speaker: Niko
nodes.dialogue: The cart's practical details now press against a feeling neither wants to simplify.{pause}A bus passes outside and briefly paints the clear cases with moving bands of blue.{pause}Mina remembers her first rushed purchase and lets the embarrassing callback do useful work.{pause}Moonmilk, Petal, and Star Pantry each promise a different future for the single open shelf slot.{pause}A quieter beat follows, where uncertainty can stay present without forcing a quick answer.

nodes.name: Awning Breath - Quiet Beat
nodes.speaker: Niko
nodes.dialogue: The choice settles into a consequence they can name without borrowing an easy slogan.{pause}The swap platform smells of wet paper, clean plastic, and somebody's cinnamon toast.{pause}Their jokes grow gentler when nostalgia and a small budget pull in different directions.{pause}Walking away remains a real choice, but now it leads to reflection instead of ending the{pause}friendship.{pause}Only then do they move, carrying the consequence forward instead of resetting at the next{pause}screen.
